subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — FinovateBank evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping (post-demo)

Hi Liam — great to meet today, thanks for your time. Quick recap from our demo and the asks we discussed: 

- Goal: roll out Redwood inference for FinovateBank's customer support summarization pipeline (phase 1).
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency under 300ms p95, SOC2 compliance evidence, predictable per-token cost, and support for on-prem/private deployment for regulated data.
- Next internal steps we heard: security review with your InfoSec (Priya) and a procurement SOW/terms review.

Attached is a first-pass stakeholder map and a short champion enablement kit (talk tracks + ROI bullets). Can you confirm the economic buyer and who will own procurement? Also, is Priya the best security contact to kick off the SOC2/compliance conversation?

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share the stakeholder map and a one-pager ROI.
2) If you're OK, let's put a 30-min call on Priya + procurement calendar next week to run through compliance and procurement ask list.
3) We'll follow-up with a draft mutual action plan and high-level pricing.

Thanks — happy to adapt.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: FinovateBank-stakeholder-map.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finovatebank.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the artifact. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: Head of Digital Channels (Tanya Ruiz) — I'll intro once we have a short summary for her.
- Procurement: Legal/procurement will need standard security/compliance docs and an initial SOW. I'll loop in procurement once Priya gives the go-ahead on security.
- Security: Priya is leading InfoSec review. She asked if you can provide a short SOC2 summary and answers to a couple of standard controls before we schedule the deep-dive.

Can you send the SOC2 summary and an ROI one-pager? Also, any talk tracks for internal champions would help — I can share those with Tanya.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Product — FinovateBank
liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finovatebank.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + stakeholder mapping (post-demo)

Hi Priya / Liam — attaching the SOC2 summary and a one-page ROI tailored to the customer support use case. Also attached is an editable stakeholder map for your internal distribution.

Key notes for InfoSec: 
- Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II; summary included (controls, data flow, retention).
- For FinovateBank's regulated PII workflows we recommend Private (VPC) deployment + customer-managed KMS — we can provide architecture diagrams and a more detailed controls matrix on request.

Champion talk tracks (short):
- For Tanya (economic buyer): emphasize predictable unit economics (savings vs. manual summarization + quicker time-to-resolution) and a canary deployment plan to minimize rollout risk.
- For product managers: highlight how Redwood's latency SLOs and KV-caching reduce per-call cost without impacting response time.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Short intro email from Liam to Tanya with the attached ROI and the stakeholder map.
2) If Priya is good for a 30-min security sync, propose Wed/Thu next week; Marcus (cc'd) can run through architecture and controls.

Attaching: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf; ROI-onepager-Finovate.pdf; FinovateBank-stakeholder-map.xlsx

Best,
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Prep notes for Priya security sync

Marissa / Marcus — prepping some quick notes and a suggested script for the security call with Priya. Keep it concise and control-forward.

Suggested call agenda (15–30 min):
1) Quick intros + scope (FinovateBank customer support summarization).
2) Data flow overview (what we store, KV cache behavior, retention defaults).
3) SOC2 highlights + where we meet encryption/KMS requirements.
4) Deployment options (Hosted vs Private/VPC) and implications for logs & auditability.
5) Requests from Finovate we should expect (network allowlist, contractual SLAs).

Talking points for Marissa to enable the champion (Liam/Tanya):
- ROI line: "We can reduce average handle time by ~20% in pilot; modeled savings and break-even on first-year committed usage are in the one-pager."
- Procurement talk track: "We support standard enterprise SOWs and can accept a reasonable carve-out for data residency; typical turnaround for procurement review is 7–10 business days once InfoSec signs off."

Marcus — can you attach the small architecture diagram and be ready to share it on screen?

-Neha
Director, Security & Compliance (Sales Support) | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finovatebank.com>, Tanya Ruiz <tanya.ruiz@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + short call to align stakeholders (proposed times)

Hi all — thanks for the quick responses. Per discussion, looping Tanya to align on economic impact and procurement expectations. 

Proposed slots for a 30-min alignment call (security + procurement + economic buyer):
- Tue, Jun 8 | 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed, Jun 9 | 13:00–13:30 PT

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min — objectives & scope (Marissa/Liam)
2) 10 min — security controls summary & deployment options (Neha/Marcus)
3) 10 min — ROI and pricing approach for pilot (Marissa)
4) 5 min — next steps & mutual action plan (owners and timelines)

Attachments included again for Tanya's review: ROI-onepager-Finovate.pdf, FinovateBank-stakeholder-map.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
